We are currently looking for experienced Truck & Trailer Mechanics for our client Kraker Truck and Trailer Care B.V. (KTTC) in Nisse.
Work on a wide range of vehicles and build a stable future in a professional workshop environment. In this role, you will use your mechanical and welding skills daily and work with modern equipment.

What will you do? 

As a mechanic, you are responsible for maintaining and repairing trucks and trailers. You will work both independently and as part of a close-knit team to keep vehicles in top condition.
• Perform maintenance and repair work on trucks and trailers in the workshop
• Use mechanical and welding skills for servicing and damage repair
• Diagnose technical issues and resolve them efficiently
• Work from the Nisse location with a fixed team of colleagues
• Work Monday to Friday, with occasional Saturday shifts
• Ensure safety and high-quality standards in every task

What do we expect from you?

• At least 6 months of experience as a truck- or trailer mechanic
• Basic technical and/or welding skills
• Independent and proactive working attitude
• Positive mindset and willingness to learn and develop
• Knowledge of the Dutch or English language.

What do we offer?

• Salary based on experience according to the CAO (scale C: €2.817 - €2.956 per month); 500-600 euro net per week
• 8% holiday allowance and 25 vacation days
•  Overtime allowance: 128.5% for the first hours, 147% thereafter
• Pension scheme according to CAO
• Dutch employment contract with long-term job security
• Health insurance support, costs: 38,49 euro net per week
• Accommodation and transport to/from work arranged:costs: 147 euro net per week
• Savings program for 24/7 drive clothing and merchandise
• A stable job with independence and responsibility
- Work with reliable equipment, clear agreements, and a team that values your skills.
